from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request
from pydantic import BaseModel

class CreditAdjustmentPayload(BaseModel):
    amount_cents: int
    idempotency_key: str
    reference_note: str

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api/v1/streams")

@router.post("/accounts/{account_number}/dispatch-credit-event")
async def dispatch_account_credit_stream_event(
    account_number: str,
    payload: CreditAdjustmentPayload,
    request: Request,
    caller: User = Depends(get_authenticated_caller),
    account_validator: AccountAuthService = Depends(get_account_auth_service)
):
    if not await account_validator.can_manage_ledger(caller.id, account_number):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=403, detail="Forbidden: caller lacks authorization to dispatch credit stream adjustments for this account")

    faust_app = request.app.state.faust_app
    credit_topic = faust_app.topic("account_ledger_adjustments", value_type=dict)

    stream_event = {
        "account_number": account_number,
        "amount_cents": payload.amount_cents,
        "initiator_id": caller.id,
        "idempotency_key": payload.idempotency_key,
        "note": payload.reference_note
    }
    await credit_topic.send(key=account_number, value=stream_event)
    return {"status": "event_streamed", "account_number": account_number}
